source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 7 (PDF 170-179), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Structural and Computational Biology) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Structural biology deals with the study of macromolecules such as proteins and nucleic acids at the level of their:
(Structural biology proteins aur nucleic acids jaise macromolecules ka kis satah par mutaala karti hai?)

options.text: tissues mein cells ka aapas ka raabta

blocks.explanation: Structural biology macromolecules (proteins aur nucleic acids) ki teen-jehti (3D) structures ka atomic satah par mutaala hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: Structural biology deals with the study of three dimensional (3D) structures of macromolecules

blocks.prompt:
2 Besides the structure of a biomolecule, structural biology gives detailed information about its:
(Structure ke ilawa structural biology biomolecule ke baare mein kya tafseeli maloomat deti hai?)

options.text: rehne ki jagah aur food chain
kaam, dynamics aur ligands se raabta

blocks.explanation: Structural biology biomolecule ki structure, kaam, dynamics aur ligands aur doosre macromolecules se raabte ki tafseel deti hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: its functions, dynamics and interaction with ligands and other macromolecules

blocks.prompt:
3 In the enzyme HIV-1 reverse transcriptase, the domain that synthesizes DNA is the:
(HIV-1 reverse transcriptase enzyme mein DNA banane wala domain kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ke structural mutaale se polymerase domain pehchana gaya jo DNA banata hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: polymerase domain (which synthesizes DNA)

blocks.prompt:
4 The RNase H domain of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase:
(HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ka RNase H domain kya karta hai?)

options.text: RNA-DNA hybrid ka RNA strand torta hai
insani receptor protein se jurta hai

blocks.explanation: RNase H domain RNA-DNA hybrid ke RNA strand ko torta hai; polymerase domain DNA banata hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: which breaks down the RNA strand of RNA-DNA hybrids

blocks.prompt:
5 Knowing the location and structure of the domains of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase has helped in:
(HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ke domains ki jagah aur structure jaanne se kis kaam mein madad mili?)

options.text: aisi antiviral dawaayein banana jo khaas inhein nishana banayen

blocks.explanation: In domains ki maloomat se aise antiviral (virus ke khilaf) dawaayein banane mein madad mili jo khaas inhi ko nishana banati hain (7.1).

book_ref.quote: Knowing the location and structure of these domains has helped in the design of antiviral drugs

blocks.prompt:
6 The well-defined active site of serine proteases is responsible for:
(Serine proteases ki wazeh active site kis kaam ki zimmedar hai?)

options.text: amino acids jor kar proteins banana

blocks.explanation: Serine proteases ki structure aik wazeh active site dikhati hai jo peptide bonds torti hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: the structure of serine proteases reveals its well-defined active site

blocks.prompt:
7 The places on a disease-causing molecule where a drug can work, usually proteins, are called:
(Bimari paida karne wale molecule par woh jagah jahan dawa kaam kar sake, jo aksar proteins hoti hai, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Structural biology bimari wale molecule par woh jagah dhoondti hai jahan dawa kaam kare; yeh aksar proteins hain aur drug targets kehlati hain (7.1).

book_ref.quote: These places are usually proteins and are called drug targets

blocks.prompt:
8 In COVID-19, the protein of SARS-CoV-2 identified as a drug target because it helps the virus enter human cells is the:
(COVID-19 mein SARS-CoV-2 ka kaun sa protein drug target bana kyun ke yeh virus ko insani cells mein dakhil hone deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spike protein virus ko insani cells mein dakhil karta hai; is ki 3D structure jaan kar ise drug target banaya gaya aur ise rokne wali vaccines aur dawaayein banayi gayin (7.1).

book_ref.quote: This protein helps the virus to enter human cells

blocks.prompt:
9 Vaccines and medicines designed against the spike protein of the coronavirus work by:
(Coronavirus ke spike protein ke khilaf bani vaccines aur dawaayein kaise kaam karti hain?)

options.text: virus ka RNA strand tor kar
host cell ki membrane ghol kar
spike protein ko rok kar taa ke virus mazeed cells infect na kare

blocks.explanation: Vaccines aur dawaayein spike protein ko rok deti hain taa ke virus mazeed cells ko infect na kar sake (7.1).

book_ref.quote: they designed vaccines and medicines that block the spike protein

blocks.prompt:
10 The way pathogens such as viruses or bacteria interact with the host's body cells is called:
(Viruses ya bacteria jaise pathogens ka host ke jism ke cells se raabta kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pathogens ka host cells se raabta host–pathogen interaction kehlata hai; structural biology dono ke proteins ki 3D structures ka mutaala karti hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: This is called host–pathogen interaction

blocks.prompt:
11 A drug that binds with the receptor protein on human cells blocks a virus by:
(Insani cells ke receptor protein se jurne wali dawa virus ko kaise rokti hai?)

options.text: virus aur receptor ka raabta rok kar, us ka dakhla band kar ke

blocks.explanation: Aisi dawa virus aur receptor ke raabte ko rokti hai aur nateeje mein virus host cells mein dakhil nahi ho paata (7.1).

book_ref.quote: Such drug inhibits the interaction of the virus with the receptor

blocks.prompt:
12 Which of the following diseases originates due to incorrect folding of proteins?
(Inmein se kaun si bimari proteins ki ghalat folding se paida hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cystic fibrosis, Parkinson's disease aur Alzheimer's disease proteins ki ghalat folding se hoti hain (kitaab mein in ke naam ghalat chhape hain) (7.1).

book_ref.quote: originate due to incorrect folding of proteins

blocks.prompt:
13 In the study of protein misfolding, structural biology provides an understanding of:
(Protein misfolding ke mutaale mein structural biology kis cheez ki samajh deti hai?)

options.text: DNA ki sequencing kaise hoti hai
folding ke pechida raaste aur misfolding se bimari kaise banti hai
crystals light ko kaise morte hain

blocks.explanation: Structural biology folding ke pechida raaston aur misfolding se bimari banne ki samajh deti hai (7.1).

book_ref.quote: Structural biology provides understanding of intricate folding pathways

blocks.prompt:
14 William Henry Bragg and William Lawrence Bragg, who developed X-ray crystallography, were awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in:
(X-ray crystallography banane wale William Henry Bragg aur William Lawrence Bragg ko Physics ka Nobel Prize kab mila?)
blocks.explanation: X-ray crystallography Bragg baap beta ne banayi aur unhein 1915 mein Physics ka Nobel Prize mila (7.2).

book_ref.quote: They were awarded 1915 Nobel Prize in Physics for their work

blocks.prompt:
15 In X-ray crystallography, the X-ray beam striking a crystal is:
(X-ray crystallography mein crystal par parne wali X-ray beam ke saath kya hota hai?)

options.text: crystal ke atoms aur molecules use khaas simton mein mor dete hain
crystal use poora jazb kar leta hai
dhaat ki tah se reflect hoti hai
magnetic lenses use focus karte hain

blocks.explanation: Jab X-ray beam crystal par parti hai to us ke atoms aur molecules beam ko khaas simton mein mor (diffract) dete hain (7.2).

book_ref.quote: atoms and molecules in the crystals diffract the x-rays beam in specific directions

blocks.prompt:
16 A 3D picture of electron density within the crystal is produced from the diffracted beams':
(Crystal ke andar electron density ki 3D tasveer diffracted beams ki kis cheez se banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diffracted beams ke zaviyon aur shiddat (intensity) se electron density ki 3D tasveer banti hai jis se molecule ki 3D structure banayi jaati hai (7.2).

book_ref.quote: From the angles and intensities of diffracted beams

blocks.prompt:
17 Since its development, X-ray crystallography has been used to analyse:
(Apni ijaad ke baad se X-ray crystallography kin cheezon ke tajziye mein istemal hui hai?)

options.text: minerals, namak, dhaatein, proteins, nucleic acids aur vitamins

blocks.explanation: Is se mukhtalif cheezon ka tajziya hua: minerals, namak, dhaatein, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleic acids aur vitamins (7.2).

book_ref.quote: minerals, salts, metals, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleic acids and vitamins

blocks.prompt:
18 Protein crystals are needed in X-ray crystallography because they:
(X-ray crystallography mein protein crystals ki zaroorat kyun hai?)

options.text: protein molecules ko baqaida dohrai tarteeb mein rakhte hain
protein ko paani mein hal karte hain
protein molecules ko khatam karte hain
computers ki zaroorat khatam karte hain

blocks.explanation: Crystals protein molecules ko aik baqaida, dohrai jaane wali tarteeb mein rakhte hain jo X-ray mein saaf image ke liye zaroori hai (7.2).

book_ref.quote: Crystals are needed because they arrange protein molecules in a regular, repeating pattern

blocks.prompt:
19 Protein crystallization often requires careful control of:
(Protein crystallization mein aksar kin cheezon ko ehtiyaat se control karna parta hai?)

options.text: temperature, pH aur namak ka concentration

blocks.explanation: Crystal banane mein ghante, din ya hafte lag sakte hain aur temperature, pH aur namak ke concentration ka ehtiyaat se control chahiye (7.2).

book_ref.quote: It often requires careful control of temperature, pH, and salt concentration

blocks.prompt:
20 The process of making protein crystals can take:
(Protein crystals banane mein kitna waqt lag sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scientists protein ko khaas mahloolon ke saath aahista milate hain; is mein ghante, din ya hafte lag sakte hain (7.2).

book_ref.quote: This process can take hours, days, or even weeks

blocks.prompt:
21 The diffraction pattern created on the detectors in X-ray crystallography is:
(X-ray crystallography mein detectors par banne wala diffraction pattern kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Crystal X-ray machine par laga kar mukhtalif zaviyon se beam daali jaati hai; mori hui beam detectors par diffraction pattern, yani nuqton ka silsila, banati hai (7.2).

book_ref.quote: a diffraction pattern (which is a series of spots) is created on the detectors

blocks.prompt:
22 In X-ray crystallography, the diffraction pattern is used to make a:
(X-ray crystallography mein diffraction pattern se kya banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spots ke zaviye aur shiddat atoms ki tarteeb batate hain; diffraction pattern se density map banaya jata hai (7.2).

book_ref.quote: Diffraction pattern is used to make a density map

blocks.prompt:
23 In the last step of protein structure determination by X-ray crystallography, the data are:
(X-ray crystallography se protein structure maloom karne ke aakhri qadam mein data ke saath kya hota hai?)

options.text: rangeen chemicals se rang diya jata hai
DNA sequencing ke liye bheja jata hai
computational programs se riyazi tajziya kar ke 3D structure banayi jaati hai

blocks.explanation: Data ka computational programs se riyazi tajziya kiya jata hai; yeh hisaab data ko protein ki 3D structure mein badal dete hain (7.2).

book_ref.quote: These calculations transform data into the 3D structure of protein

blocks.prompt:
24 Computational biology integrates knowledge from:
(Computational biology kin uloom ka ilm milati hai?)

options.text: biology, computer science, mathematics aur statistics

blocks.explanation: Computational biology kayi uloom ka majmua hai: yeh biology, computer science, mathematics aur statistics mila kar biological data ka tajziya karti hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: It integrates knowledge from biology, computer science, mathematics, and statistics

blocks.prompt:
25 The importance of computational biology lies in its ability to:
(Computational biology ki ahmiyat kis salahiyat mein hai?)

options.text: bare datasets sambhalna, chhupe patterns dhoondna aur paishgoi ke models banana
lab ke tamam tajurbon ki jagah lena
light microscope se zinda cells dekhna

blocks.explanation: Computational biology bare datasets sambhal sakti hai, chhupe patterns dhoond sakti hai aur paishgoi karne wale models bana sakti hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: its ability to handle large datasets, uncover hidden patterns, and generate predictive models

blocks.prompt:
26 A genome is:
(Genome kya hai?)

options.text: jandaar ke tamam proteins ka set
kisi jandaar ke aik cell mein DNA ka mukammal set

blocks.explanation: Genomics genomes ka mutaala hai; genome kisi jandaar ke aik cell mein DNA ka mukammal set hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: which are the complete set of DNA within a single cell of an organism

blocks.prompt:
27 The entire set of proteins produced by an organism is called its:
(Kisi jandaar ke banaye tamam proteins ke set ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Proteomics proteins ka bare paimane par mutaala hai aur proteome, yani jandaar ke tamam proteins, ka naqsha banata hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: Proteomics aims to map the entire set of proteins (the proteome) produced by an organism

blocks.prompt:
28 The application of computer technology to store, retrieve and analyse DNA, RNA and protein sequences is:
(DNA, RNA aur protein sequences ko mehfooz karne, nikaalne aur tajziya karne mein computer technology ka istemal kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bioinformatics computer technology se biological data, maslan DNA, RNA aur protein sequences, sambhalti aur tajziya karti hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: the application of computer technology to manage and analyze biological data

blocks.prompt:
29 Computational biology accelerates drug discovery by:
(Computational biology dawaon ki daryaft ko kaise tez karti hai?)

options.text: dawaayein sirf janwaron par test kar ke
dawaon ke proteins aur doosre molecules se raabte ki paishgoi kar ke
dawa ke molecules ki sequencing kar ke

blocks.explanation: Yeh mumkin drug targets dhoondti, dawa ke asar ki simulation karti aur proteins se dawa ke raabte ki paishgoi kar ke daryaft tez karti hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: It accelerates the drug discovery process by predicting how drugs interact with proteins

blocks.prompt:
30 By identifying genetic variations associated with diseases, computational biology can lead to:
(Bimariyon se mutaliq genetic farq pehchan kar computational biology kis cheez tak le ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Genetic research mein DNA sequences ka tajziya bimari se juri tabdeeliyan dhoondta hai aur personalized medicine (har mareez ke mutabiq ilaaj) tak le jata hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: can lead to the development of personalized medicine

blocks.prompt:
31 In evolutionary biology, computational tools compare genetic information across species to:
(Evolutionary biology mein computational tools mukhtalif species ki genetic maloomat ka muqabla kis liye karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Computational tools species ki genetic maloomat ka muqabla kar ke irtiqai (evolutionary) rishte dobara banate hain (7.3).

book_ref.quote: helping to reconstruct evolutionary relationships

blocks.prompt:
32 GenBank is a comprehensive public database of:
(GenBank kis cheez ka mukammal public database hai?)
blocks.explanation: GenBank nucleotide sequences ka public database hai jis mein hawale aur biological tafseel bhi hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: It is a comprehensive public database of nucleotide sequences

blocks.prompt:
33 The database that provides 3D structural data of large biological molecules such as proteins and nucleic acids is:
(Proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare biological molecules ka 3D structural data kaun sa database deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Protein Data Bank (PDB) bare biological molecules ka 3D data deta hai aur dawaayein design karne mein madad karta hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: This database provides 3D structural data of large biological molecules

blocks.prompt:
34 Ensembl is a:
(Ensembl kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ensembl aik genome browser hai jo mukhtalif species ke genome sequences, gene models aur comparative genomics dikhata hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: It is a genome browser providing information on genome sequences

blocks.prompt:
35 BLAST stands for:
(BLAST ka poora naam kya hai?)

options.text: Biological Linear Analysis of Sequence Types
Bioinformatics Library of All Sequence Tools

blocks.explanation: BLAST (Basic Local Alignment Search Tool) proteins ke amino acids ya DNA ke nucleotides jaisi bunyadi sequences ka muqabla karta hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: BLAST (Basic Local Alignment Search Tool)

blocks.prompt:
36 BLAST is used to:
(BLAST kis kaam aata hai?)

options.text: homologous sequences pehchanna aur na-maloom genes ka kaam batana

blocks.explanation: BLAST homologous sequences pehchanne, na-maloom genes ke kaam ki paishgoi aur irtiqai rishton ke mutaale mein madad deta hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: It helps identify homologous sequences, predict functions of unknown genes

blocks.prompt:
37 The sequence alignment tool that compares a query sequence to a database of sequences to find regions of similarity is:
(Woh sequence alignment tool jo aik query sequence ko sequences ke database se mila kar mushabehat ke hisse dhoondta hai:)
blocks.explanation: FASTA query sequence ko database ki sequences se mila kar mushabehat ke hisse dhoondta hai; yeh protein aur nucleotide databases mein talaash karta hai (7.3).

book_ref.quote: compares a query sequence to a database of sequences to find regions of similarity

blocks.prompt:
38 Similarity between DNA, RNA or protein sequences due to shared ancestry is called:
(Mushtarka aabaa-o-ajdaad ki wajah se DNA, RNA ya protein sequences ki mushabehat ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sequence homology mushtarka ajdaad ki wajah se DNA, RNA ya protein sequences ki mushabehat hai (7.4).

book_ref.quote: Sequence homology refers to the similarity between DNA, RNA, or protein sequences due to shared ancestry

blocks.prompt:
39 Homologous sequences in different species that originated from a common ancestral gene during speciation are:
(Mukhtalif species ki woh homologous sequences jo speciation ke dauran aik mushtarka gene se banin, kya kehlati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Orthologs mukhtalif species ki sequences hain jo speciation mein aik mushtarka gene se banin; aksar in ka kaam aik jaisa rehta hai (7.4).

book_ref.quote: Sequences in different species that originated from a common ancestral gene during speciation

blocks.prompt:
40 Paralogs are sequences:
(Paralogs kaisi sequences hain?)

options.text: mukhtalif species ki, speciation mein bani
be-ta'alluq proteins ki jin ki shakal milti ho
sirf virus ke spike proteins ki
aik hi species ki, gene duplication se bani

blocks.explanation: Paralogs aik hi species ki sequences hain jo gene ke duplicate hone se banin; in mein naye kaam paida ho sakte hain (7.4).

book_ref.quote: Sequences within the same species that originated from gene duplication

blocks.prompt:
41 Which statement about homologous sequences is correct?
(Homologous sequences ke baare mein kaun si baat sahi hai?)

options.text: Orthologs aksar wohi kaam rakhte hain, jab ke paralogs naye kaam paida kar sakte hain
Paralogs hamesha mukhtalif species mein hote hain
Orthologs sirf gene duplication se bante hain
Homologous sequences ka koi mushtarka ajdaad nahi

blocks.explanation: Orthologs aksar species mein aik jaisa kaam rakhte hain; paralogs aik hi asal gene se ho kar bhi naye kaam paida kar sakte hain (7.4).

book_ref.quote: Orthologs often retain the same function across species

blocks.prompt:
42 If an unknown gene is homologous to a gene with a known function, the unknown gene:
(Agar aik na-maloom gene kisi maloom kaam wale gene ka homologous ho, to na-maloom gene ke baare mein kya kaha ja sakta hai?)

options.text: aksar milta julta kaam rakhta hoga
us ka koi kaam nahi ho sakta

blocks.explanation: Sequence homology kaam ka ishara deti hai: jo gene kisi maloom kaam wale gene ka homologous ho, us ka kaam bhi aksar milta julta hota hai (7.4).

book_ref.quote: it is likely to have a similar function

blocks.prompt:
43 Homologous genes in model organisms are studied to:
(Model organisms ke homologous genes ka mutaala kis liye kiya jata hai?)

options.text: insani bimariyon ki samajh haasil karne ke liye

blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif species mein bimari ke homologous genes pehchanna bimari ka mechanism samjhata hai; model organisms ke genes insani bimariyon ki samajh dete hain (7.4).

book_ref.quote: Homologous genes in model organisms can be studied to gain insights into human diseases

blocks.prompt:
44 According to structural homology, proteins with similar three-dimensional structures:
(Structural homology ke mutabiq milti julti 3D structures wale proteins:)

options.text: hamesha bilkul aik jaisi sequences rakhte hain
sequences zyada na milne par bhi aksar milte julte kaam karte hain

blocks.explanation: Structural homology mushtarka ajdaad ki wajah se 3D structures ki mushabehat hai; aise proteins sequences mukhtalif hone par bhi aksar milte julte kaam karte hain (7.4).

book_ref.quote: Proteins with similar structures often perform similar functions, even if their sequences are not highly similar

blocks.prompt:
45 Structural homology is crucial in drug design because drugs:
(Dawaayein design karne mein structural homology kyun ahem hai?)

options.text: sirf DNA sequences se banti hain
sirf cell walls par kaam karti hain
kisi protein ko jaane baghair banti hain
aksar khaas protein structures se jurne ke liye banayi jaati hain

blocks.explanation: Dawaayein aksar khaas protein structures se jurne ke liye banayi jaati hain, is liye proteins ke structural rishte jaan kar zyada mufeed dawaayein banti hain (7.4).

book_ref.quote: structural homology is crucial in drug design
